title: Triple exceptional point with unitary paths of unfolding in a three-site fermionic Swanson-like model
summary: A fermionic three-site generalization of the popular bosonic Swanson model is studied as providing an exactly solvable five-parametric example of the quantum-mechanical unitary-evolution process leading to an ultimate loss of the observability and fall in an exceptional-point singularity (EP3). The instant of degeneracy is found to have an explicit one-parametric form. Its unitarity-compatible vicinity (i.e., the corridor of access to EP3) is also specified in closed form.
